package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"

	"github.com/Azure/ARO-HCP/test/cmd/aro-hcp-tests/slot-manager/slots"
	"github.com/Azure/ARO-HCP/test/pkg/leaseenv"
	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/util/sets"
)

type poolRecord struct {
	Environment        string
	Name               string
	ProvisioningRegion string
	PhysicalCount      int
	Slots              []slots.ExpandedSlot
	ProvisionedGroups  [][]string
	Journal            []string
	Exports            []string
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func main() {
	c, err := slots.LoadCatalog(os.Args[1])
	must(err)
	records := []poolRecord{}
	inventories, err := c.AssetInventories()
	must(err)
	for _, env := range c.EnvironmentNames() {
		for _, p := range c.Environments[env].Pools {
			raw := slots.ExpandSlotsForPool(env, p)
			r := poolRecord{Environment: env, Name: p.Name, ProvisioningRegion: p.EffectiveIdentityProvisioningRegion(), PhysicalCount: p.EffectiveIdentityContainerProvisioningCount(), Slots: raw}
			for _, s := range raw {
				r.ProvisionedGroups = append(r.ProvisionedGroups, s.ProvisionedIdentityContainerNames())
				s.Subscriptions.E2E.ID = "e2e00000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
				s.Subscriptions.Infrastructure.ID = "1f000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"
				region := s.Region
				if region == "" {
					region = "westus3"
				}
				state := slots.AcquiredSlotState{Version: 2, DeployEnvironment: s.DeployEnvironment, RuntimeRegion: region, Slot: s, LeasedResourceName: s.ResourceName, Leases: slots.LeaseSet{Primary: slots.Lease{ResourceType: s.ResourceType, ResourceName: s.ResourceName}}}
				for _, req := range s.AssetRequirements {
					if req.Kind == slots.KindMockIdentities {
						state.Slot.Assets.MockIdentities = &leaseenv.MockIdentityBundlePayload{SlotName: s.ResourceName, SubscriptionID: s.Subscriptions.E2E.ID,
							MSI:             leaseenv.MockPrincipal{ClientID: "a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", PrincipalID: "a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", CertificateName: "fixture-msi"},
							Backend:         leaseenv.MockPrincipal{ClientID: "a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003", PrincipalID: "a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004", CertificateName: "fixture-backend"},
							ClustersService: leaseenv.MockPrincipal{ClientID: "a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005", PrincipalID: "a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006", CertificateName: "fixture-cs"}}
					}
					if req.Kind != slots.KindInfrastructureIdentities {
						continue
					}
					inventory, ok := slots.AssetInventoryForRequirement(inventories, req)
					if !ok {
						panic("missing asset inventory")
					}
					groups := []string{}
					leases := []slots.Lease{}
					for i := 0; i < req.UnitsPerSlot; i++ {
						name := inventory.ResourceName(i)
						groups = append(groups, name)
						leases = append(leases, slots.Lease{ResourceType: inventory.AssetPool.ResourceType, ResourceName: name})
					}
					state.Leases.Assets = map[slots.AssetKind][]slots.Lease{req.Kind: leases}
					state.Slot.Assets.InfrastructureIdentities = &slots.ResolvedInfrastructureIdentities{Allocation: slots.AllocationLeased, ResourceGroups: groups, Identities: []string{"fixture-managed-identity"}}
				}
				must(state.ValidateForAdmission())
				journal, err := yaml.Marshal(&state)
				must(err)
				r.Journal = append(r.Journal, string(journal))
				exports := slots.NewRuntimeContractBuilder()
				must(slots.AddCoreRuntimeExports(exports, &state, s.Subscriptions.E2E.Name, "/fixture/profile with spaces"))
				r.Exports = append(r.Exports, string(exports.MarshalShell()))
			}
			records = append(records, r)
		}
	}
	boskos, err := slots.ExpectedBoskosResources(c)
	must(err)
	types := slots.RenderBoskosTypesBlock(c)
	resources, err := slots.RenderBoskosResourcesBlock(c)
	must(err)
	var callers struct {
		Callers []struct {
			Source string            `json:"source"`
			Test   string            `json:"test"`
			Env    map[string]string `json:"env"`
		} `json:"callers"`
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2])
	must(err)
	must(json.Unmarshal(data, &callers))
	candidates := map[string][]string{}
	regions := map[string]map[string]string{}
	for _, caller := range callers.Callers {
		env, err := c.ResolveEnvironmentForDeployEnv(caller.Env["ARO_HCP_DEPLOY_ENV"])
		must(err)
		subscriptions := caller.Env["MULTISTAGE_PARAM_OVERRIDE_ALLOWED_SUBSCRIPTIONS"]
		if subscriptions == "" {
			subscriptions = caller.Env["ALLOWED_SUBSCRIPTIONS"]
		}
		split := func(s string) sets.Set[string] {
			if s == "" {
				return nil
			}
			return sets.New(strings.Split(s, ",")...)
		}
		pools, err := c.CandidatePools(env, split(subscriptions), split(caller.Env["ALLOWED_LOCATIONS"]), caller.Env["MULTISTAGE_PARAM_OVERRIDE_LOCATION"])
		must(err)
		names := []string{}
		for _, p := range pools {
			names = append(names, p.Name)
		}
		candidates[caller.Source+"#"+caller.Test] = names
		mode, err := c.RegionModeForEnvironment(env)
		must(err)
		selection, err := resolveRegionSelection(c, env, mode, caller.Env["MULTISTAGE_PARAM_OVERRIDE_LOCATION"], caller.Env["LOCATION_WEIGHTS"], "1234567890")
		must(err)
		selected := map[string]string{}
		for _, p := range pools {
			region := selection.RuntimeRegion
			if region == "" {
				region = p.Region
			}
			selected[p.Name] = region
		}
		regions[caller.Source+"#"+caller.Test] = selected
	}
	result := struct {
		Pools           []poolRecord
		Assets          []slots.AssetInventory
		Boskos          map[string][]string
		BoskosTypes     string
		BoskosResources string
		Candidates      map[string][]string
		Regions         map[string]map[string]string
	}{records, inventories, boskos, types, resources, candidates, regions}
	output, err := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
	must(err)
	fmt.Println(string(output))
}
